hyp: Paʼpatusu, aʼna taweri tahshiramiachin nunterawe. Nimara ku ahketeware uʼmararawe, inasu ku nituhterinwe. Ahke ira inaran ikirure, inapuchin nihpirinwe kahsu nahtanawe. Nahpatunke, waʼwa, shaʼwike mamanen kuʼwara wahpuru iʼshanake nanpeyahtaraʼsuwe.
